description: Model ids offered by Google Antigravity, as the union across subscription tiers. Source: https://antigravity.google/docs/models (2026-11-18). Claude Sonnet 5.5 and Opus 5.5 thinking variants are available on Google AI Ultra and non-trial Google AI Pro subscriptions, not Free/Plus or Enterprise. Claude Sonnet 4.6, Opus 4.6, and GPT-OSS-120b remain available until their announced removal on 2026-11-18. Gemini 4 Carbon, Argon, and Hydrogen are available across Pro/Ultra tiers. Only models with catalog pricing/context data are included.
